programme.title: Age Defiantly - Beyond the Cholesterol Myth Upstream Cardiology AI Diagnostics and the Truth About GLP-1s with Dr Sanjay Bhojraj
programme.desc: In this episode of Age Defiant host Mark Young welcomes back cardiologist and functional medicine pioneer Dr Sanjay Bhojraj to challenge the conventional medical systems reliance on pharmacology and tech Dr Bhojraj argues that while the standard system isolates metrics like LDL cholesterol up to 80 of cardiovascular disease could be melted away by addressing root-cause lifestyle issues like sleep stress trauma and environmental toxicities The conversation explores the shifting landscape of patient advocacy highlighting how AI can act as a powerful research assistant to eliminate clinical biases and help patients ask better questions Turning to todays massive weight-loss trend Mark and Dr Bhojraj deliver a critical warning regarding GLP-1 agonists They discuss the biological realities of receptor overloading the psychological impacts on dopamine and human connection and the severe risks of medically induced malnutrition Dr Bhojraj shares details on his GLP Rescue program designed to help patients navigate these treatments safely before wrapping up with unsexy but essential daily habits—and a surprising mental health tool—that keep the human engine thriving well into your second fifty
